target.development_target: the frozen R3 source-local descending midrank percentile
target.external_target: descending midrank percentile among all strictly positive finite author-reported LOG_CONVERTED_LFQ_ABUNDANCE values in the same silver-source measurement batch

development_selection.population: all 2,724 frozen R3 eligible observations from the three original laboratory anchors
development_selection.tie_breaker: smaller regularization then lexical model identifier
development_selection.final_refit: fit the selected configuration on all frozen R3 development observations

external_evaluation.laboratory_anchor: University of Southern Denmark / Russian Academy of Sciences study
external_evaluation.analysis_population: strictly positive source rows whose direct UniProt accession exists in the frozen R3 sequence-feature table
external_evaluation.access_condition: public author-accessible source; not a protected lockbox and not an independent evaluator

feature_policy.feature_standardization: fit only on all frozen R3 development observations

metrics.primary: equal-weight mean external measurement-batch Spearman correlation
secondary: equal-weight mean external measurement-batch mean absolute error
equal-weight mean external measurement-batch root mean square error
metrics.constant_rank_metric_policy: undefined; report MAE and RMSE only

uncertainty.method: external measurement-batch cluster bootstrap percentile interval

negative_control.method: permute R3 development targets independently within each development measurement batch while holding observed nested-selected alpha fixed

claim_boundary: A positive or negative result is an author-run exploratory OOD test on one public external laboratory source. It cannot establish independent evaluation, no-author-team scientific reproduction, material design, clinical utility, causal mechanism or submission readiness.
